🎣 FISH. SHOOT. EXPLORE.

Cast your rod, reel creatures out of the water, then SHOOT them out of the sky to claim your catch!

🔫 Collect & upgrade powerful guns
🎣 Discover rare fish & unlock stronger rods
🌊 Explore new zones, secrets & creatures
⚔️ Summon and fight massive bosses [SOON]
🏆 Complete hunts & earn exclusive rewards
🦀 Catch fish even while you’re offline
💎 Open cases & collect rare gear
☠️ Steal valuable catches from other players

Some things in these waters are MUCH rarer than others…

How far can you progress?

⚠️ Reeled is in BETA — expect frequent updates, new content, and occasional bugs.

👍 Like + Favorite if you’re enjoying Reeled!
